title: Police Blotter: 26 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Twenty-six people were booked into the Webb County Jail on November 14, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds — DWI, assault, theft, evading arrest and more. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Twenty-six people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Saturday, November 14, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.
